g.text: PRESENCE
"I'm here, I'm
not leaving"
TOUCH
consented hand,
shoulder, presence
SILENCE
let tears finish,
thoughts gather
HOLD SPACE
suffering witnessed,
not fixed!
KNOW YOURSELF
triggers owned,
feelings managed!
PRESENCE = being fully there: body still, mind unhurried, phone away, eyes soft.
"I'm here, I'm not leaving" — said by the CHAIR, not the mouth. Two present minutes beat
twenty distracted ones. Presence is the intervention when nothing else fits.
TOUCH (therapeutic!): consented hand-hold ("may I hold your hand?") · forearm for courage ·
shoulder for solidarity · blanket-tucking for care. ASK culture/faith/gender/trauma first;
watch flinches (stop instantly!); document significant touch. Touchless option: close sitting
+ eyes + voice does 80% of the work.
SILENCE (skilled!): after bad news (let it land!) · amid tears (don't mop feelings with
words!) · before decisions (thoughts gather!) · with the dying (companionship beyond speech!).
Tolerate YOUR discomfort — fleeing silence abandons them in it. Cap: re-open gently ("I'm
here — tell me when ready").
HOLDING SPACE: witness suffering WITHOUT fixing ("I can't take this away, but I won't leave
you in it"). Fix-it reflex ("don't cry, be strong!") serves YOUR comfort, not theirs. Grief,
fear, dying — sat WITH, not solved (M04 deepens!).
SELF-AWARENESS: know YOUR triggers (stillbirth after your miscarriage? alcoholic father?) —
owned triggers stay managed; denied ones leak (avoidance, tears, anger). Debrief, reflect
(Gibbs!), swap when overwhelmed — self-care IS patient safety (PRO-II!).
LINKS: PRO-I M3/M7 boundaries + reflection · GER M6 dying · INF M02 document.
MANTRA: "sit, stay, silent, hand — witness, don't fix."
